text: Chief: fresh-context review of the layout module = ACCEPT-WITH-NITS. Verified purity, full-structure determinism law, exact tiling incl. '\n' kept as a fragment character and surrogates never split, per-ref piece coverage with r0/r1, injective ids (content-addressed AnnotationIds), no doubles/JVM API in shared sources. Fixing before close: Int overflow of width/height budgets (Paginator.scala:32-33, metrics.scala:60-67) → multiplyExact/Long + InvalidSpec; AwtMeasurer identity must reflect the measured family (fail when resolved font family != style.family); metrics.scala:137-138 hidden defaults → Left; measurer-name validation (whitespace/control chars corrupt the receipt render); document leading-whitespace line behaviour; add tab/NBSP/zero-width/lone-surrogate/zero-advance to LayoutGens.
